mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_amuleto: You can't leave the dungeon without the Amulet of Yendor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bloqueado: The way deeper is still blocked.
comando.pixeldungeon.novarun: The run is over. Choose your heroes!
item.pixeldungeon.espada_curta_desgastad: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
item.pixeldungeon.cajado_do_mago.descric: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.
item.pixeldungeon.adaga.descricao: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.
item.pixeldungeon.luvas_cravejadas.descr: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.
item.pixeldungeon.florete.descricao: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
item.pixeldungeon.maca.descricao: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.
item.pixeldungeon.ankh.descricao: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Use it to bring back an ally who has died.
tela.pixeldungeon.kit: Starts with: %s, cloth armor and a ration.
tela.pixeldungeon.run_em_andamento: Someone is already in the dungeon: you will join the current run on depth 1.
classe.pixeldungeon.guerreiro.descricao: The Warrior endures extra damage with shielding granted by his _broken seal._ The seal can be moved between armors and _transfers a single upgrade._
classe.pixeldungeon.mago.descricao: The Mage is an arcane expert and carries a _magical staff_ that's stronger than a wand. The staff can be _imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds.
classe.pixeldungeon.ladino.descricao: The Rogue can evade enemies and strike from invisibility using his _cloak of shadows._ He also _detects secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
classe.pixeldungeon.cacadora.descricao: The Huntress is a master of thrown weapons and has a _magical bow_ with infinite arrows. She also travels through tall grass _without trampling it._
classe.pixeldungeon.duelista.descricao: The Duelist is a weapons master who can use her weapon to trigger a _special weapon ability._ This special ability is _different for every weapon._
classe.pixeldungeon.clerigo.descricao: The Cleric is a divine spellcaster who uses their unique _holy tome_ to channel divine magic. They can _learn and upgrade spells_ via talents.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.espere_ankh: You died. You are now a spectator until someone uses an ankh on you.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.fim_da_run: All heroes have died. The run is over.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reviveu: %s was brought back to life by %s's ankh!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ninguem_pra_revive: There is no dead ally to bring back.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reabrir_menu: Type /heroi to open the hero menu again.
comando.pixeldungeon.ja_na_run: You are already in the run.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_pano.descr: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
dica.pixeldungeon.surpresa_forte: Surprise attacks hit close to max damage
mensagem.pixeldungeon.saida_trancada: The exit is locked while the boss of this depth is alive.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selado: The level is sealed! You can't flee in the middle of the fight.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chefe_derrotado: %s was defeated! The exit of the depth is open.
efeito.pixeldungeon.muco_caustico.aviso: Caustic ooze eats your flesh. Wash it away!
item.pixeldungeon.bolha_de_gosma.descric: A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it. It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.varinha_sem_carga: Your wand fizzles; it must not have enough charge.
classe.pixeldungeon.guerreiro.kit: Starts with: worn shortsword, cloth armor with the broken seal and a ration.
classe.pixeldungeon.mago.kit: Starts with: mage's staff (with the wand of magic missile), cloth armor and a ration.
classe.pixeldungeon.ladino.kit: Starts with: dagger, cloak of shadows, cloth armor and a ration.
classe.pixeldungeon.cacadora.kit: Starts with: studded gloves, spirit bow, cloth armor and a ration.
classe.pixeldungeon.duelista.kit: Starts with: rapier, cloth armor and a ration. Press V to use the weapon ability.
classe.pixeldungeon.clerigo.kit: Starts with: cudgel, holy tome, cloth armor and a ration.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ponto_de_talento: You gained a talent point! Press %s to choose.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.identifica: Does nothing for now: in the mod, every item is already identified.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.grama: Does nothing for now: the sewers don't have tall grass yet.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.plantas: Does nothing for now: there are no plants in the mod yet.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_saudavel.d:
_+1:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _4 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.

_+2:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _6 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_veteran:
_+1:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _1.75x faster_ and armor _2.5x faster_.

_+2:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _when he equips it_.
talento.pixeldungeon.raiva_provocada.des:
_+1:_ When any shielding on the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack (within 5 turns) deals _3 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When any shielding on the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack deals _5 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.determinacao_de_fer:
_+1:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 1_.

_+2:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 2_.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_empoderado:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Mage _2 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Mage _3 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_do_estudio:
_+1:_ The Mage identifies wands _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Mage identifies wands _when he uses them_.
talento.pixeldungeon.magia_prolongada.de:
_+1:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack (within 5 turns) deals _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack deals _2 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.barreira_de_apoio.d:
_+1:_ The Mage gains _3 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.

_+2:_ The Mage gains _5 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.
talento.pixeldungeon.racoes_guardadas.de:
_+1:_ The Rogue can find _2 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Rogue can find _3 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

Supply rations are eaten quickly, restore a moderate amount of satiety, heal 5 HP, and restore 1 charge to the cloak of shadows.
_+1:_ The Rogue identifies rings _2x faster_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he equips it_.

_+2:_ The Rogue identifies rings _when he equips them_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he picks it up_.
talento.pixeldungeon.golpe_surpresa.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue deals _1-2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.

_+2:_ The Rogue deals _2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.
_+1:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every other turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 3_.

_+2:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 5_.
talento.pixeldungeon.recompensa_da_natur:
_+1:_ The Huntress can find _4 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Huntress can find _6 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_sobrevi:
_+1:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _when she hits with them_.
_+1:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow, her next melee attack against that enemy (within 5 turns) deals _2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow, her next melee attack against that enemy deals _3 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.auxilio_da_natureza:
_+1:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin for _3 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated near her.

_+2:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin for _5 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated near her.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_fortaleced:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _2 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _3 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_aventur:
_+1:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _1.75x faster_.

_+2:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _when she equips them_ and armor _2.5x faster_.
talento.pixeldungeon.golpe_paciente.desc:
_+1:_ If the Duelist stands still for 1 turn before a melee attack, she will deal _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ If the Duelist stands still for 1 turn before a melee attack, she will deal _2 bonus damage_.
_+1:_ The Duelist gains _3 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.

_+2:_ The Duelist gains _5 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.
talento.pixeldungeon.magias_saciadas.des:
_+1:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _3 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.

_+2:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _5 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.des:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition_, a spell that reveals whether an item is cursed at the cost of _3 charges_.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition_ at the cost of _2 charges_.
talento.pixeldungeon.luz_abrasadora.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+3 damage_.

_+2:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+5 damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.escudo_de_luz.descr:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light_, an instant spell that grants them _2-4 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light_, granting _3-6 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.cortar.descricao: The Duelist cleaves the enemy she is aiming at for _+3 damage_ with guaranteed accuracy. If it kills, she can cleave again within 5 turns for free.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.furtivo.descrica: The Duelist blinks up to _5 tiles_ where she is looking and becomes _invisible for 2 turns_.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.combinacao.descr: A guaranteed hit that deals _+3 damage_ for each time the Duelist hit before. Not hitting anything for 5 turns (15 after a kill) resets the combo.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.estocada.descric: The Duelist lunges at an enemy 1 tile away and strikes for _+5 damage_ with guaranteed accuracy.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.golpe_pesado.des: A guaranteed hit that _dazes for 5 turns_ (half accuracy and evasion). On a surprise attack it deals _+3 damage_.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_so_duel: Only the Duelist knows how to use weapon abilities.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_sem_for: You are not strong enough to use this weapon's ability.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_sem_car: You don't have enough energy to use this ability.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_fora_de: That target is out of range.
item.pixeldungeon.capa_das_sombras.descr: A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory by the Rogue many years ago. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time. The more it is used, the stronger it becomes.
dica.pixeldungeon.capa_usar: Right click: turn invisible (again to stop)
mensagem.pixeldungeon.capa_sem_carga: Your cloak hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.capa_acabou: Your cloak ran out of energy.
item.pixeldungeon.racao_de_suprimentos.d: A small ration, eaten quickly. Heals 5 HP and restores 1 charge to the cloak of shadows.
item.pixeldungeon.arco_espiritual.descri: A bow made of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled, this bow will conjure a magical arrow.
dica.pixeldungeon.arco_atirar: Right click: shoot a spirit arrow
item.pixeldungeon.tomo_sagrado.descricao: A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. It grows more powerful as it is used, gaining more charges.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.tomo_sem_carga: Your tome doesn't have enough charges.
magia.pixeldungeon.luz_guia.descricao: Shoots a bolt of light where the Cleric is aiming, dealing _2-8 damage_ and _illuminating_ the target. The next physical attack against an illuminated enemy is _guaranteed to hit_.
magia.pixeldungeon.arma_celestial.descri: Enchants the weapon with holy energy: every hit deals _2 extra magical damage_ for 50 turns. Takes no time to cast.
magia.pixeldungeon.arma_celestial.lancad: Your weapon glows with holy light.
magia.pixeldungeon.armadura_sagrada.desc: Covers the Cleric with glyphs of light: every hit taken is _blocked by 1_ more for 50 turns. Takes no time to cast.
magia.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.descr: The Cleric focuses their senses on the item in their _off hand_ and learns whether it is cursed.
magia.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.sem_i: Hold the item in your off hand.
magia.pixeldungeon.escudo_de_luz.descric: Creates a barrier of light between the Cleric and the _enemy they are aiming at_, granting extra armor against it for 5 turns. Takes no time to cast.
dica.pixeldungeon.selo: Broken seal: %s shielding when health drops to half
